The '''''Fusion Flame''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]<ref name="MF" /> from the waning [[Time/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Age">In [[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']], it's established that the eponymous ship, also called the ''Stellar Envoy'', was constructed in [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]]. Since Bammy Decree found a record of the ''Envoy''{{'s}} race with the craft in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the ship existed in this era.</ref> It once raced another ship, later called the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']], around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] and was soundly defeated. The victorious [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] recorded the victory in the winning ship's [[SuperFlow IV/Legends|SuperFlow IV droid brain]]. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the ship that had beaten the ''Fusion Flame'', by then given the name ''Stellar Envoy'', was being restored by a mechanic named [[Bammy Decree/Legends|Bammy Decree]]. He discovered the pilot's record of the race against the ''Fusion Flame'' while analyzing the brain.<ref name="MF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Fusion Flame'' was mentioned in [[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']], a [[2008]] novel by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="MF" />
